newsitem.title: USA: CAI Wireless hit with second lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: CAI Wireless hit with second lawsuit.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc said a second class-action lawsuit was filed against it on January 7, alleging various violations of Federal securities laws.

The suit, filed by the Philadelphia-based law firm of Berger & Montague in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of New York, alleges the company issued false and misleading statements to inflate its stock price, a spokesman for the company said.
CAI, based in Albany, N.Y., said it will vigorously defend itself against the suit, which it called meritless and unlikely to result to any liability to the company.
Shareholders filed the first suit against the company in November. That suit is still pending in the Northern District of New York, the company said.
